descriptionText:
Lot of 33 vintage Aircel Comics: Warlock 5, Warlock 5 Book II, Warlocks and the Warlocks Special Edition (1987-1989).
Classic Aircel series from the late-1980s independent comics boom. Includes Warlock 5 #1 and #2, a long run of #9-22, the complete 6-issue Book II, Warlocks #1-10 and the 1989 Special Edition.
You will receive every comic listed below (33 comics). The first photo shows all of them; the rest show each comic up close.
